name: Pinocchio
summary: A bluffing matching game where players claim clothing cards match by color or type and opponents risk growing noses by challenging lies.
rules_text: Each player gets a face-down stack of Clothing cards. A central pile holds played cards face down. On your turn draw your top card privately and place it face down on the central pile. You must announce a color and clothing type that matches the previous announcement in at least one attribute (color or type). If your real card matches, tell the truth; if not, you must bluff and announce a matching combination you do not have. After the announcement any opponent may shout Taradiddle to challenge, first caller flips the top card. If announcement was false, announcer takes a Long Nose card; if true, challenger takes one. If no one challenges, play passes left and the next player must match the announced claim, not the actual hidden card. When all stacks are empty, fewest Long Nose cards wins.
rating_reason: Bluff-catching card game with hidden hands, clear strategy
